acquisition method: Data-dependent acquisition selected the ten most abundant precursor ions for HCD fragmentation using an isolation width of 1.6​Da, fill time of 110​ms, and an AGC target of 1e5.
cleavage agent: Search parameters included Trypsin/P specificity, up to 2 missed cleavages, a fixed modification of carbamidomethyl cysteine, and variable modifications of oxidized methionine, pyroglutamic acid for Q, and N-terminal acetylation.
collision energy: Peptides were fragmented using a normalized collision energy of 27, and fragment spectra were acquired with a resolution of 17,500 at m/z​= 200.
enrichment method: The tandem-affinity purified products were analyzed on 8% SDS-PAGE, gels were then silver stained (ProteoSilver, Sigma) and processed for mass spectrometry.
